error-EngineTrap: The engine of scripts stopped on an error of its own
error-ErrorUnreadable: The script threw something that could not be read
error-InvalidInput: The script got an input it could not read
error-OutputInvalid: The script ended on an output that could not be read
error-OutputTooLarge: The output of the script is over {{limit}} bytes
error-ResultNotString: The script ended on a value that is not text
error-ScriptPending: The script did not finish: it waits for something that cannot come
error-Timeout: The script ran out of time
error-Timeout-limit: The script ran longer than {{limit}} ms
error-Violation: The worker of the script broke the rules of a run
error-WorkerDied: The worker of the script stopped
error-WorkerOutOfMemory: The worker of the script ran out of memory
notice-body-not-writable: The body of this request is of type {{type}}: a script cannot write it.
notice-chain-too-long: {{scripts}} scripts are over the limit of {{limit}} in one send: none ran.
notice-collection-unreadable: The collection {{name}} could not be read: its scripts did not run.
notice-effect-name-forbidden: Effect dropped: “{{name}}” is not a name a script may use.
notice-effects-text-too-large: Effects rejected: a text is over {{limit}} bytes.
notice-effects-too-many-sends_one: Effects rejected: {{count}} socket send, over the limit of {{limit}}.
notice-effects-too-many-sends_other: Effects rejected: {{count}} socket sends, over the limit of {{limit}}.
notice-effects-too-many-variables_one: Effects rejected: {{count}} variable, over the limit of {{limit}}.
notice-effects-too-many-variables_other: Effects rejected: {{count}} variables, over the limit of {{limit}}.
notice-effects-variable-too-large: Effects rejected: the variable “{{name}}” is over {{limit}} bytes.
notice-effects-variables-too-large: Effects rejected: the variables add up to over {{limit}} bytes.
notice-folder-unreadable: The folder {{name}} could not be read: its scripts did not run.
notice-lines-cut: Lines past {{limit}} in one note were cut.
notice-message-too-large: A message was over the size a script may read: onMessage ran without its text.
notice-no-reconnect: A script ran before this connection opened: it does not reconnect on its own.
notice-note-cut: What the scripts said was too long: the rest was cut.
notice-output-cut: Output cut. Console lines dropped: {{lines}}. Test cases dropped: {{cases}}.
notice-queue-full_one: {{count}} message arrived while the queue was full: no script ran on it.
notice-queue-full_other: {{count}} messages arrived while the queue was full: no script ran on them.
notice-response-body-unreadable: The body of the response is too large or is not text: a script cannot read it.
notice-script-too-large: A script of {{event}} is over {{limit}} bytes and did not run.
notice-secret-unreadable: The variable “{{name}}” is a secret: a script cannot read it.
notice-sends-dropped_one: {{count}} socket.send did not leave: the connection was gone, or past {{limit}} a second.
notice-sends-dropped_other: {{count}} socket.send did not leave: the connection was gone, or past {{limit}} a second.
notice-socket-sends-cap: socket.send: at most {{limit}} sends in one run.
notice-variables-full: The values of scripts are full: what this script set was not kept.
